findings.evidence: We only store your credit card information if you choose to set up an authorized account with one of our Sites. In that case, it is stored on a secure computer in an encrypted format. If you do not set up an account, you will have to enter your credit card information each time you order.
findings.rationale: The policy does not explicitly mention collecting financial data types, but it does disclose storing credit card information under certain conditions.
findings.verifier_reason: The policy evidence describes the circumstances under which financial data (specifically credit card information) is stored, but it does not explicitly state that the app collects financial data. Therefore, the evidence supports an undisclosed collection gap.

findings.evidence: We may share your information within the BWW organization and with our franchisees, with current and future affiliated companies, and with reputable third parties as needed to provide better services to you.
